name: General
summary: Starting points from Anthropic that apply to any role, for a customer whose industry has no pack.

anthropic_starting_points.name: skill-creator
anthropic_starting_points.note: Adopt. Anthropic's eval loop for creating, testing and tuning a skill; author and evaluate every twin skill with it.

anthropic_starting_points.name: template-skill
anthropic_starting_points.note: Adopt. A bare SKILL.md with name and description; the seed of our own skill template. It is in no plugin, so copy it by hand. Its licence is not stated.

anthropic_starting_points.name: docx
anthropic_starting_points.note: Adopt in Claude Code and the API; the Claude apps have their own. Test first, as the README disclaimer says.

anthropic_starting_points.name: xlsx
anthropic_starting_points.note: Adopt, with the same caveat as docx.

anthropic_starting_points.name: pptx
anthropic_starting_points.note: Adapt. Decks need the customer's template and brand; layer a brand skill on top.

anthropic_starting_points.name: mcp-builder
anthropic_starting_points.note: Adopt for building a custom connector where the directory has none. It is a kit step, not something a twin user runs.

anthropic_starting_points.name: claude-api
